_note: PAPER ONLY. No wallet, no Phantom, no signing. Data: DexScreener + GeckoTerminal public APIs.
_reentry_note: After a profitable exit, same mint/ticker is blocked for reentry_cooldown_min minutes. After a losing exit (stop or net loss), mint and ticker are banned until midnight Europe/Warsaw. User decision 20.11.
_stop_at_note: No entry cutoff since 20.11 12:26 (user: desk keeps trading continuously on paper). Set an ISO time here to stop new entries.
_ladder_note: Variant S (20.11 13:xx, backtest on real GeckoTerminal 1-min candles): stop -6%; peak>=+10% -> stop +3% (covers ~3 pp round-trip costs); at +15% sell 50% and stop +3%; trailing 12 pp from +24%, 20 pp from +100%, 25 pp from +200%. Stop never moves down. Previous (19.11): stop -8%, +12% -> 0%.
_size_note: 20% equity per trade (start $25 -> $5). $0.02 fee would eat ~1%/side at smaller sizes. Max 4 open. User decision 19.11.
_dead_liq_note: If pair liquidity < $1000 or no DexScreener quote for 10+ min, close as total loss (-100%), reason rug/brak płynności. MTM marks such positions at $0.
_rugcheck_note: Final gate before every paper buy (user decision 19.11): RugCheck /v1/tokens/<mint>/report. Reject: mint/freeze authority, LP locked <80% on traded pair (graduated pump.fun pools report 100% burned), top10 holders excl. pool/locker >35%, single holder >15%, creator >10%, rugged flag, score_normalised >30, any danger-level risk, permanent delegate/transfer hook/transfer fee. Unreachable -> skip buy (fail-closed). Cache 10 min.
_entry_note: entry.mode 'now' since 20.11 variant S (pullback P2 lost in live 0/4 and in backtest). 'pullback' params kept for reference.
_copybook_note: PAPER copy of public wallet @unipcs (user decision 20.11): own $25 paper book (state/copybook.json), mirrors new buys paid >=0.005 SOL or >=$1 USDC/USDT (add-ons and airdrops skipped), mirrors sells proportionally (>=90% = full exit), 20% of copy equity per copy, max 4, desk cost model. Public RPC only, no keys. Never touches any wallet.
_strict_note: Variant S filter (user 20.11 'przerób desk tak aby zarabiał', paper): pair age >= 6 h, 1h change 0..+100% (no parabolic pumps), 6h change >= +10%, buy now (pullback entry off: backtest worse), max 2 open, 20% per trade. Backtest: no robust edge; positive mean comes from one outlier.
